summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing ordinary share repurchases under existing buyback programs. Purchases from Goldman Sachs International totaled 24 million shares between August 3-7 at prices ranging from 114.70 to 117.70 pence per share, with volume-weighted averages per day. The shares are intended for cancellation, reducing outstanding capital. This is a routine ongoing buyback disclosure, not a new special situation. The registrant acts as issuer executing capital returns under previously announced programs, with no deal-specific terms or advisors disclosed.
